684: 			for _, entry := range entries {
685: 				log.Printf("DEBUG: Embedded file: %s (dir: %v)", entry.Name(), entry.IsDir())
686: 			}
687: 		}
688: 	} else {
689: 		log.Println("DEBUG: Embedded FS does not support ReadDir")
690: 	}
691: 
692: 	// Health check endpoint
693: 	app.router.GET("/health", func(c *gin.Context) {
694: 		c.JSON(200, gin.H{
695: 			"status":     "healthy",
696: 			"version":    Version,
697: 			"build_time": BuildTime,
698: 			"git_commit": GitCommit,
699: 			"timestamp":  time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
700: 		})
701: 	})
702: 
703: 	// Version endpoint
704: 	app.router.GET("/version", func(c *gin.Context) {
705: 		c.JSON(200, gin.H{
706: 			"version":    Version,
707: 			"build_time": BuildTime,
708: 			"git_commit": GitCommit,
709: 		})
710: 	})
711: 
712: 
713: 
714: 	gatewayTransport := socketProxyTransport(app.config.GatewaySocket)
715: 	gatewayBase := gatewayBaseURL(app.config)
716: 
717: 	registerGatewayPrefix := func(prefix, upstreamPrefix string) error {
718: 		proxy, err := newPrefixProxy(gatewayBase, gatewayTransport, prefix, upstreamPrefix)
719: 		if err != nil {
720: 			return err
721: 		}
722: 		handler := func(c *gin.Context) {
723: 			proxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
724: 		}
725: 		app.router.Any(prefix, handler)
726: 		app.router.Any(prefix+"/*path", handler)
727: 		return nil
728: 	}
729: 
730: 	if err := registerGatewayPrefix("/network", "/"); err != nil {
731: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to configure /network proxy: %w", err)
732: 	}
733: 	if err := registerGatewayPrefix("/explorer", "/explorer"); err != nil {
734: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to configure /explorer proxy: %w", err)
735: 	}
736: 	if err := registerGatewayPrefix("/gateway", "/"); err != nil {
737: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to configure /gateway proxy: %w", err)
738: 	}
739: 	if err := registerGatewayPrefix("/turn", "/api/turn"); err != nil {
740: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to configure /turn proxy: %w", err)
741: 	}
742: 	// DVE public verification pages — proxied through the gateway to the backend socket
743: 	if err := registerGatewayPrefix("/dve", "/dve"); err != nil {
744: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to configure /dve proxy: %w", err)
745: 	}
746: 	// Network-monitor API routes — proxy to the gateway which has Go handler
747: 	// equivalents for the Next.js API routes excluded from the static export.
748: 	// These are handled inside the /api/*path catch-all below rather than as
749: 	// explicit Gin routes, because Gin rejects a catch-all + explicit routes
750: 	// on the same prefix.
751: 
752: 	// API proxy to backend
753: 	api := app.router.Group("/api")
754: 	{
755: 		api.Any("/*path", func(c *gin.Context) {
756: 			// Update-status endpoint — handled locally; avoids proxying GitHub
757: 			// calls through the backend subprocess.
758: 			if c.Request.URL.Path == "/api/v1/system/update" {
759: 				if c.Request.Method == http.MethodOptions {
760: 					c.Status(http.StatusOK)
761: 					return
762: 				}
763: 				if c.Request.Method != http.MethodGet {
764: 					c.JSON(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, gin.H{"error": "method not allowed"})
765: 					return
766: 				}
767: 				if app.upd == nil {
768: 					c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
769: 						"available":       false,
770: 						"current_version": GitCommit,
771: 						"latest_tag":      "",
772: 						"checked_at":      time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
773: 					})
774: 					return
775: 				}
776: 				status, err := app.upd.CheckUpdateAvailable()
777: 				if err != nil {
778: 					log.Printf("[updater] check failed: %v", err)
779: 					c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
780: 						"available":       false,
781: 						"current_version": GitCommit,
782: 						"latest_tag":      "",
783: 						"checked_at":      time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
784: 					})
785: 					return
786: 				}
787: 				c.JSON(http.StatusOK, status)
788: 				return
789: 			}
790: 
791: 			// Update-apply endpoint — triggers self-update and restart.
792: 			if c.Request.URL.Path == "/api/v1/system/update/apply" {
793: 				if c.Request.Method == http.MethodOptions {
794: 					c.Status(http.StatusOK)
795: 					return
796: 				}
797: 				if c.Request.Method != http.MethodPost {
798: 					c.JSON(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, gin.H{"error": "method not allowed"})
799: 					return
800: 				}
801: 				if app.upd == nil {
802: 					c.JSON(http.StatusServiceUnavailable, gin.H{"error": "updater not configured"})
803: 					return
804: 				}
805: 				c.JSON(http.StatusAccepted, gin.H{"message": "applying update, server will restart"})
806: 				// Flush the response before exec replaces the process.
807: 				c.Writer.(http.Flusher).Flush()
808: 				go func() {
809: 					if err := app.upd.TriggerUpdate(); err != nil {
810: 						log.Printf("[updater] apply error: %v", err)
811: 					}
812: 				}()
813: 				return
814: 			}
815: 
816: 			// Detect network-monitor paths and proxy to the gateway instead
817: 			// of the backend, since the gateway has Go handler equivalents.
818: 			if strings.HasPrefix(c.Request.URL.Path, "/api/network-monitor/") {
819: 				nmProxy, nmErr := newPrefixProxy(gatewayBase, gatewayTransport, "", "")
820: 				if nmErr == nil {
821: 					nmProxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
822: 					return
823: 				}
824: 			}
825: 			// Per-DVE agent API: /api/agent/{dveId}/... → KNIRVGATEWAY dynamicAgentProxy
826: 			// (cannot register as a named Gin route; /api/*path catch-all owns the prefix)
827: 			if strings.HasPrefix(c.Request.URL.Path, "/api/agent/") {
828: 				agentProxy, agentErr := newPrefixProxy(gatewayBase, gatewayTransport, "", "")
829: 				if agentErr == nil {
830: 					agentProxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
831: 					return
832: 				}
833: 			}
834: 			// Construct backend URL
835: 			backendURL := backendBaseURL(app.config) + c.Request.RequestURI
836: 			transport := &http.Transport{}
837: 			if app.config.BackendSocket != "" {
838: 				transport = unixSocketTransport(app.config.BackendSocket)
839: 			}
840: 
841: 			// Create proxy request
842: 			req, err := http.NewRequest(c.Request.Method, backendURL, c.Request.Body)
843: 			if err != nil {
844: 				c.JSON(500, gin.H{"error": "Failed to create proxy request"})
845: 				return
846: 			}
847: 
848: 			// Copy headers
849: 			for key, values := range c.Request.Header {
850: 				for _, value := range values {
851: 					req.Header.Add(key, value)
852: 				}
853: 			}
854: 
855: 			// Make request to backend
856: 			client := &http.Client{
857: 				Timeout:   60 * time.Second,
858: 				Transport: transport,
859: 				// Do not follow redirects automatically
860: 				CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
861: 					return http.ErrUseLastResponse
862: 				},
863: 			}
864: 			resp, err := client.Do(req)
865: 			if err != nil {
866: 				log.Printf("Proxy error: %v", err)
867: 				c.JSON(http.StatusServiceUnavailable, gin.H{"error": "Backend service unavailable"})
868: 				return
869: 			}
870: 			defer resp.Body.Close()
871: 
872: 			// Copy response headers
873: 			for key, values := range resp.Header {
874: 				for _, value := range values {
875: 					c.Header(key, value)
876: 				}
877: 			}
878: 
879: 			// Copy response status and body
880: 			c.Status(resp.StatusCode)
881: 			io.Copy(c.Writer, resp.Body)
882: 		})
883: 	}
884: 
885: 	app.router.Any("/tunnel", func(c *gin.Context) {
886: 		c.Request.URL.Path = "/status"
887: 		proxy, err := newPrefixProxy(gatewayBase, gatewayTransport, "/tunnel", "")
888: 		if err != nil {
889: 			c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"error": "Failed to configure tunnel proxy"})
890: 			return
891: 		}
892: 		proxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
893: 	})
894: 	app.router.Any("/tunnel/*path", func(c *gin.Context) {
895: 		trimmed := strings.TrimPrefix(c.Request.URL.Path, "/tunnel")
896: 		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "/" {
897: 			c.Request.URL.Path = "/status"
898: 		} else if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "/status") {
899: 			c.Request.URL.Path = trimmed
900: 		} else {
901: 			c.Request.URL.Path = "/api" + trimmed
902: 		}
903: 
904: 		proxy, err := newPrefixProxy(gatewayBase, gatewayTransport, "", "")
905: 		if err != nil {
906: 			c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"error": "Failed to configure tunnel proxy"})
907: 			return
908: 		}
909: 		proxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
910: 	})

912: 	// WebSocket proxy — must be registered before NoRoute so the upgrade
913: 	// request reaches the backend instead of being served as a static file.
914: 	// httputil.ReverseProxy handles the 101 Switching Protocols upgrade by
915: 	// hijacking the underlying net.Conn, which works through Gin's wrapper.
916: 	var backendWS *url.URL
917: 	var wsTransport *http.Transport

647: // findAvailablePort tries to listen on the given port, and if it's in use,
648: // tries subsequent ports until it finds one available.
649: func (s *Server) findAvailablePort(startPort int) (net.Listener, error) {
650: 	const maxAttempts = 100
651: 	for port := startPort; port < startPort+maxAttempts; port++ {
652: 		addr := fmt.Sprintf(":%d", port)
653: 		listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", addr)
654: 		if err != nil {
655: 			s.logger.Debug("Port in use, trying next",
656: 				zap.Int("port", port),
657: 				zap.Error(err),
658: 			)
659: 			continue
660: 		}
661: 		s.logger.Info("Found available port",
662: 			zap.Int("port", port),
663: 		)
664: 		return listener, nil
665: 	}
666: 	return nil, fmt.Errorf("no available port found after %d attempts", maxAttempts)
667: }

669: // Start starts the HTTP server
670: func (s *Server) Start() error {
671: 	ctx := context.Background()
672: 
673: 	// Start tunnel service
674: 	if err := s.tunnelService.Start(ctx); err != nil {
675: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start tunnel service: %w", err)
676: 	}
677: 
678: 	// Start payment service
679: 	if err := s.paymentService.Start(ctx); err != nil {
680: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start payment service: %w", err)
681: 	}
682: 
683: 	// Start TURN server with blockchain integration
684: 	if s.turnServer != nil {
685: 		if err := s.turnServer.Start(ctx); err != nil {
686: 			s.logger.Warn("Failed to start TURN server",
687: 				zap.Error(err))
688: 		}
689: 	}
690: 
691: 	// Setup CORS
692: 	c := cors.New(cors.Options{
693: 		AllowedOrigins:   []string{"*"},
694: 		AllowedMethods:   []string{"GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"},
695: 		AllowedHeaders:   []string{"*"},
696: 		AllowCredentials: true,
697: 	})
698: 
699: 	handler := c.Handler(wrapWithSecurityHeaders(s.router))
700: 
701: 	s.httpServer = &http.Server{
702: 		Addr:         fmt.Sprintf(":%d", s.config.Port),
703: 		Handler:      handler,
704: 		ReadTimeout:  30 * time.Second,
705: 		WriteTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
706: 		IdleTimeout:  120 * time.Second,
707: 	}

709: 	var listener net.Listener
710: 	var err error
711: 
712: 	// Listen on TCP port
713: 	listener, err = s.findAvailablePort(s.config.Port)
714: 	if err != nil {
715: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to find available port: %w", err)
716: 	}
717: 	// Extract the actual port from the listener
718: 	s.actualPort = listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
719: 	if s.actualPort != s.config.Port {
720: 		s.logger.Info("Using dynamic port",
721: 			zap.Int("port", s.actualPort),
722: 			zap.Int("requested", s.config.Port),
723: 		)
724: 	} else {
725: 		s.actualPort = s.config.Port
726: 	}
727: 
728: 	s.logger.Info("HTTP server listening",
729: 		zap.String("address", s.httpServer.Addr),
730: 	)
731: 
732: 	if err := s.httpServer.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
733: 		return fmt.Errorf("server failed: %w", err)
734: 	}
735: 
736: 	return nil
737: }

801: // wrapWithSecurityHeaders adds security-related HTTP headers to all responses.
802: func wrapWithSecurityHeaders(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
803: 	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
804: 		w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "SAMEORIGIN")
805: 		w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "frame-ancestors 'self' http://localhost:8080 http://localhost:8090")
806: 		w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
807: 		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
808: 	})
809: }

811: // newSocketProxy creates a reverse proxy that dials a Unix socket and forwards
812: // requests to the given target base URL.
813: func newSocketProxy(socketPath, targetBase string) *httputil.ReverseProxy {
814: 	transport := &http.Transport{
815: 		DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) (net.Conn, error) {
816: 			return net.Dial("unix", socketPath)
817: 		},
818: 	}
819: 	target, _ := url.Parse(targetBase)
820: 	proxy := httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(target)
821: 	proxy.Transport = transport
822: 	// Strip CORS headers from the upstream response so the gateway's own CORS
823: 	// middleware is the single authority.  Without this the backend can inject
824: 	// Access-Control-Allow-Origin alongside the gateway's wildcard, producing
825: 	// the "multiple values" error browsers reject.
826: 	proxy.ModifyResponse = func(resp *http.Response) error {
827: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Origin")
828: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Headers")
829: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Methods")
830: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials")
831: 		// Strip frame/CSP headers from the upstream response so the gateway's own
832: 		// wrapWithSecurityHeaders (SAMEORIGIN, proper frame-ancestors CSP) is
833: 		// authoritative.  Without this the backend's SecurityHeadersMiddleware
834: 		// (X-Frame-Options: DENY, default-src 'self') overrides the gateway's
835: 		// permissive settings and blocks iframing in components like the DVE
836: 		// verification panel.
837: 		resp.Header.Del("X-Frame-Options")
838: 		resp.Header.Del("Content-Security-Policy")
839: 		return nil
840: 	}
841: 	return proxy
842: }

844: // dynamicAgentProxy returns an http.Handler that routes /api/agent/{dveId}/*
845: // to the per-DVE KNIRVAGENT's Unix socket (agent-{dveId}.sock).
846: // The proxy is created on first use and cached per DVE ID.
847: func (s *Server) dynamicAgentProxy() http.Handler {
848: 	var (
849: 		mu     sync.RWMutex
850: 		cache  = make(map[string]*httputil.ReverseProxy)
851: 	)
852: 	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
853: 		// Extract DVE ID from path: /api/agent/{dveId}/rest/of/path
854: 		path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/agent/")
855: 		parts := strings.SplitN(path, "/", 2)
856: 		if len(parts) == 0 || parts[0] == "" {
857: 			http.Error(w, `{"error":"missing dve id"}`, http.StatusBadRequest)
858: 			return
859: 		}
860: 		dveID := parts[0]
861: 
862: 		socketPath := filepath.Join(s.config.AgentSocketDir, fmt.Sprintf("agent-%s.sock", dveID))
863: 
864: 		// Check if socket exists before proxying
865: 		if _, err := os.Stat(socketPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
866: 			s.logger.Warn("Agent socket not found for DVE",
867: 				zap.String("dveID", dveID),
868: 				zap.String("socket", socketPath))
869: 			http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf(`{"error":"agent not running for dve %s"}`, dveID),
870: 				http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
871: 			return
872: 		}
873: 
874: 		// Get or create a cached proxy for this DVE
875: 		mu.RLock()
876: 		proxy, ok := cache[dveID]
877: 		mu.RUnlock()
878: 		if !ok {
879: 			mu.Lock()
880: 			// Double-check inside write lock
881: 			if proxy, ok = cache[dveID]; !ok {
882: 				targetBase := fmt.Sprintf("http://knirvagent-%s", dveID)
883: 				proxy = newSocketProxy(socketPath, targetBase)
884: 				cache[dveID] = proxy
885: 				s.logger.Info("Created agent proxy",
886: 					zap.String("dveID", dveID),
887: 					zap.String("socket", socketPath))
888: 			}
889: 			mu.Unlock()
890: 		}
891: 
892: 		// Rewrite the URL path: strip /api/agent/{dveId}
893: 		r.URL.Path = "/" + strings.Join(parts[1:], "/")
894: 		r.URL.RawPath = ""
895: 
896: 		proxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
897: 	})
898: }

909: // handleInnerAgentWS upgrades the HTTP connection to a WebSocket and
910: // pipes data to/from the KNIRVAGENT's Unix socket for inner agent
911: // streaming and input forwarding.
912: func (s *Server) handleInnerAgentWS(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
913: 	vars := mux.Vars(r)
914: 	dveID := vars["dveId"]
915: 	sessionID := vars["sessionId"]
916: 
917: 	if dveID == "" {
918: 		http.Error(w, `{"error":"dveId required"}`, http.StatusBadRequest)
919: 		return
920: 	}
921: 
922: 	socketPath := filepath.Join(s.config.AgentSocketDir, fmt.Sprintf("agent-%s.sock", dveID))
923: 	if _, err := os.Stat(socketPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
924: 		s.logger.Warn("Inner agent WS: socket not found", zap.String("dveID", dveID), zap.String("socket", socketPath))
925: 		http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf(`{"error":"agent not running for dve %s"}`, dveID), http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
926: 		return
927: 	}
928: 
929: 	conn, err := innerAgentUpgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
930: 	if err != nil {
931: 		s.logger.Error("Inner agent WS upgrade failed", zap.String("dveID", dveID), zap.Error(err))
932: 		return
933: 	}
934: 	defer conn.Close()
935: 
936: 	unixConn, err := net.DialTimeout("unix", socketPath, 5*time.Second)
937: 	if err != nil {
938: 		s.logger.Error("Inner agent WS: Unix dial failed", zap.String("dveID", dveID), zap.String("socket", socketPath), zap.Error(err))
939: 		conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"type":"error","data":"cannot connect to agent"}`))
940: 		return
941: 	}
942: 	defer unixConn.Close()
943: 
944: 	if sessionID != "" {
945: 		httpReq := "GET /api/inner/" + sessionID + "/stream HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: unix\r\n\r\n"
946: 		if _, err := unixConn.Write([]byte(httpReq)); err != nil {
947: 			s.logger.Error("Inner agent WS: stream request failed", zap.String("dveID", dveID), zap.Error(err))
948: 			return
949: 		}
950: 	}
951: 
952: 	errCh := make(chan error, 2)
953: 
954: 	go func() {
955: 		buf := make([]byte, 4096)
956: 		for {
957: 			n, err := unixConn.Read(buf)
958: 			if n > 0 {
959: 				msg, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"type": "data", "data": string(buf[:n])})
960: 				if writeErr := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg); writeErr != nil {
961: 					errCh <- writeErr
962: 					return
963: 				}
964: 			}
965: 			if err != nil {
966: 				endMsg, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"type": "stream_end"})
967: 				conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, endMsg)
968: 				errCh <- err
969: 				return
970: 			}
971: 		}
972: 	}()
973: 
974: 	go func() {
975: 		for {
976: 			_, message, err := conn.ReadMessage()
977: 			if err != nil {
978: 				errCh <- err
979: 				return
980: 			}
981: 			var msg struct {
982: 				Type    string `json:"type"`
983: 				Data    string `json:"data,omitempty"`
984: 				Session string `json:"session,omitempty"`
985: 			}
986: 			if err := json.Unmarshal(message, &msg); err != nil {
987: 				continue
988: 			}
989: 			switch msg.Type {
990: 			case "input":
991: 				targetSession := msg.Session
992: 				if targetSession == "" {
993: 					targetSession = sessionID
994: 				}
995: 				if targetSession == "" {
996: 					continue
997: 				}
998: 				body := fmt.Sprintf("data=%s", msg.Data)
999: 				inputReq := fmt.Sprintf("POST /api/inner/%s/input HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: unix\r\nContent-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s",
1000: 					targetSession, len(body), body)
1001: 				unixConn.Write([]byte(inputReq))
1002: 			case "ping":
1003: 				conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"type":"pong"}`))
1004: 			}
1005: 		}
1006: 	}()
1007: 
1008: 	<-errCh
1009: }

2171: func (s *Server) runRollupLoop() {
2172: 	if s.rollupService == nil {
2173: 		return
2174: 	}
2175: 
2176: 	pollInterval := s.rollupPollInterval
2177: 	if pollInterval <= 0 {
2178: 		pollInterval = 30 * time.Second
2179: 	}
2180: 
2181: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(pollInterval)
2182: 	go func() {
2183: 		defer ticker.Stop()
2184: 		for {
2185: 			select {
2186: 			case <-s.ctx.Done():
2187: 				return
2188: 			case <-ticker.C:
2189: 				batch, err := s.rollupService.BuildNextBatch(s.ctx)
2190: 				if err != nil {
2191: 					log.Printf("Warning: Failed to build rollup batch: %v", err)
2192: 					continue
2193: 				}
2194: 				if batch == nil {
2195: 				} else {
2196: 					submitted, err := s.rollupService.SubmitBatch(s.ctx, batch.ID)
2197: 					if err != nil {
2198: 						log.Printf("Warning: Failed to submit rollup batch %s: %v", batch.ID, err)
2199: 						continue
2200: 					}
2201: 
2202: 					log.Printf("Rollup batch submitted: %s (heights %d-%d)", submitted.ID, submitted.StartHeight, submitted.EndHeight)
2203: 				}
2204: 
2205: 				reconciled, err := s.rollupService.ReconcileWithOracle(s.ctx)
2206: 				if err != nil {
2207: 					log.Printf("Warning: Failed to reconcile rollup batches with oracle: %v", err)
2208: 					continue
2209: 				}
2210: 				if reconciled > 0 {
2211: 					log.Printf("Reconciled %d rollup batch statuses from oracle", reconciled)
2212: 				}
2213: 			}
2214: 		}
2215: 	}()
2216: }

2642: 	}

2649: 	// Stop HTTP server
2650: 	if s.httpServer != nil {

2653: 		if err := s.httpServer.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {

2661: 	// Clean up Unix socket file after HTTP server shutdown

2663: 		if err := os.Remove(s.config.API.SocketPath); err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {

2670: 	// Stop oracle manager (root node only)
2671: 	if s.oracleManager != nil {
2672: 		if err := s.oracleManager.Stop(context.Background()); err != nil {
2673: 			log.Printf("Error stopping oracle manager: %v", err)

2676: 		}

2679: 	// Stop Hasher gRPC server

2683: 		} else {

2685: 		}
2686: 	}

2688: 	// Stop Hasher integration client
2689: 	if s.hasherIntegration != nil {
2690: 		if err := s.hasherIntegration.Close(); err != nil {
2691: 			log.Printf("Error closing Hasher integration: %v", err)

Architecture Overview

46: 47:

KNIRVARENA is a Vite-built static web app (TS/React/Three.js with WASM, fonts, textures, sounds). Its dist/ output is ~70+ files. Following the existing patterns:

48: 49:
50: 
51:   packages/KNIRVARENA/
52:     npm run build
53:     ↓
54:   dist/  (HTML, JS chunks, CSS, WASM, assets, fonts, textures, sounds, icons)
55:     tar -czf
56:     ↓
57:   packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvarena/bin/knirvarena.tar.gz  ← gzip compressed
58:     //go:embed
59:     ↓
60:   pkg/knirvarena/embedded.go  →  ExtractEmbeddedApp()
61:     │                            └─ decompress + extract to $APPDATA/knirvarena/
62:     ▼
63:   pkg/knirvarena/manager.go   →  Manager.Start()
64:                                     ├─ extract bundle
65:                                     ├─ start in-process net/http file server on Unix socket
66:                                     ├─ WebSocket upgrade handler
67:                                     └─ health check via socket
68:     │
69:     ▼
70:   sockets/arena.sock  (Unix socket, no TCP port)
71:     │
72:     ▼
73:   KNIRVGATEWAY proxies /arena/* → arena.sock  (external access)
74:   Internal services → direct WebSocket to arena.sock  (internal access)
75:
76:
77: 78:
79: Key design decision: The arena server runs in-process (not a subprocess binary) because the arena dist is static files—there's no standalone binary to spawn. The manager starts a Go net/http server bound to a Unix socket. This mirrors the subprocess lifecycle (Start/Stop/HealthCheck) without requiring a child process. 80:
81: 82:
83: ⚠ Known issue with gorilla/websocket upgrade via Unix socket: The Go stdlib net/http.Server does not natively support WebSocket upgrade over Unix sockets when proxied by an external HTTP server (the gateway). To work around this, the arena server should handle WebSocket upgrades natively by checking r.Header.Get("Upgrade") and hijacking the connection, OR use a simple HTTP handler that wraps http.Hijacker. The included client.go provides a WS dial helper that connects directly to the Unix socket.

144: func writeFileAtomically(path string, data []byte, perm os.FileMode) error {
145:     dir := filepath.Dir(path)
146:     if err := ensureDir(dir); err != nil {
147:         return err
148:     }
149:     tmpFile, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, filepath.Base(path)+".tmp-*")
150:     if err != nil {
151:         return fmt.Errorf("failed to create temp file: %w", err)
152:     }
153:     tmpPath := tmpFile.Name()
154:     defer func() { _ = tmpFile.Close(); _ = os.Remove(tmpPath) }()
155:     if _, err := tmpFile.Write(data); err != nil {
156:         return fmt.Errorf("failed to write temp file: %w", err)
157:     }
158:     if err := tmpFile.Chmod(perm); err != nil {
159:         return fmt.Errorf("failed to chmod temp file: %w", err)
160:     }
161:     if err := tmpFile.Close(); err != nil {
162:         return fmt.Errorf("failed to close temp file: %w", err)
163:     }
164:     if err := os.Rename(tmpPath, path); err != nil {

170: // ExtractEmbeddedApp extracts the embedded arena bundle to destDir.
171: // If destDir is empty, uses the default extraction directory.
172: // Returns the path to the extracted files.
173: func ExtractEmbeddedApp(destDir string) (string, error) {
174:     if len(embeddedBundle) == 0 {
175:         return "", fmt.Errorf("embedded knirvarena bundle is empty")
176:     }
177: 
178:     // Decompress gzip
179:     if len(embeddedBundle) < 2 || embeddedBundle[0] != 0x1f || embeddedBundle[1] != 0x8b {
180:         return "", fmt.Errorf("embedded bundle is not gzip compressed")
181:     }
182:     gzr, err := gzip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(embeddedBundle))
183:     if err != nil {
184:         return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create gzip reader: %w", err)
185:     }
186:     defer gzr.Close()
187: 
188:     // Resolve destination
189:     if strings.TrimSpace(destDir) == "" {
190:         var err error
191:         destDir, err = defaultExtractDir()
192:         if err != nil {
193:             return "", err
194:         }
195:     }
196: 
197:     if err := os.RemoveAll(destDir); err != nil {
198:         return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to clean old extraction: %w", err)
199:     }
200:     if err := ensureDir(destDir); err != nil {
201:         return "", err
202:     }
203: 
204:     // Extract tar archive
205:     tr := tar.NewReader(gzr)
206:     for {
207:         hdr, err := tr.Next()
208:         if err == io.EOF {
209:             break
210:         }
211:         if err != nil {
212:             return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to read tar entry: %w", err)
213:         }
214: 
215:         target := filepath.Join(destDir, hdr.Name)
216: 
217:         // Security: prevent path traversal outside destDir
218:         if !strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Clean(target), filepath.Clean(destDir)+string(os.PathSeparator)) {
219:             return "", fmt.Errorf("illegal tar path: %s", hdr.Name)
220:         }
221: 
222:         switch hdr.Typeflag {
223:         case tar.TypeDir:
224:             if err := ensureDir(target); err != nil {
225:                 return "", err
226:             }
227:         case tar.TypeReg:
228:             if err := ensureDir(filepath.Dir(target)); err != nil {
229:                 return "", err
230:             }
231:             f, err := os.OpenFile(target, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_TRUNC, os.FileMode(hdr.Mode))
232:             if err != nil {
233:                 return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create %s: %w", target, err)
234:             }
235:             if _, err := io.Copy(f, tr); err != nil {
236:                 f.Close()
237:                 return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to write %s: %w", target, err)
238:             }
239:             f.Close()
240:         }
241:     }
242: 
243:     return destDir, nil
244: }

428: func (m *Manager) handleWebSocket(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
429:     if r.Header.Get("Upgrade") != "websocket" {
430:         http.Error(w, "not a websocket request", http.StatusBadRequest)
431:         return
432:     }
433:     // WebSocket upgrade — hijack the connection
434:     hj, ok := w.(http.Hijacker)
435:     if !ok {
436:         http.Error(w, "hijacking not supported", http.StatusInternalServerError)
437:         return
438:     }
439:     conn, bufrw, err := hj.Hijack()
440:     if err != nil {
441:         http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
442:         return
443:     }
444:     defer conn.Close()
445: 
446:     // For now, this is a placeholder WS handler.
447:     // The actual arena WebSocket protocol will be implemented separately.
448:     // Send a simple text frame acknowledging the connection.
449:     m.logger.Info("KNIRVARENA WebSocket connection established",
450:         zap.String("remote", conn.RemoteAddr().String()))
451: 
452:     // Respond with a 101 Switching Protocols handshake
453:     bufrw.WriteString("HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols\r\n")
454:     bufrw.WriteString("Upgrade: websocket\r\n")
455:     bufrw.WriteString("Connection: Upgrade\r\n")
456:     bufrw.WriteString("Sec-WebSocket-Accept: " + computeAcceptKey(r.Header.Get("Sec-WebSocket-Key")) + "\r\n")
457:     bufrw.WriteString("\r\n")
458:     bufrw.Flush()
459: 
460:     // Simple echo for proof-of-life
461:     buf := make([]byte, 4096)
462:     for {
463:         n, err := conn.Read(buf)
464:         if err != nil {
465:             break
466:         }
467:         // Echo back (real impl will use proper WS framing)
468:         conn.Write(buf[:n])
469:     }
470: }
471: 
472: // computeAcceptKey computes the Sec-WebSocket-Accept value per RFC 6455.
473: func computeAcceptKey(key string) string {
474:     if key == "" {
475:         return ""
476:     }
477:     // The magic GUID per RFC 6455
478:     const magicGUID = "258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11"
479:     h := sha1.New()
480:     h.Write([]byte(key + magicGUID))
481:     return base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))
482: }

Let me update the anchored summary with the new facts from this conversation turn. The previous summary is quite detailed. I've now created the test files, so I need to update the "In Progress" and "Done" sections accordingly. Let me construct the updated summary.

Key updates:
- Created `manager_test.go` and `embedded_test.go` successfully (moved from In Progress to Done for the test creation)
- Still need to run `go mod tidy && go vet`
- The rest of the Makefile, backend go.mod, main.go, gateway edits are still pending

The previous summary has a lot of detail that's still accurate. I need to preserve it and merge in the new facts.

## Goal
- Implement KNIRVARENA static web app integration into KNIRVSERVER per `arena_implementation.html` plan: create `pkg/knirvarena/` package with embedded bundle, in-process Unix-socket HTTP/WS server, lifecycle manager, internal client, Makesfile targets, backend integration, and gateway proxy route.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Follow existing patterns from `pkg/knirvgraph/` and `pkg/knirvagent/` (embedded.go, manager.go, client.go, go.mod).
- Arena runs in-process (not subprocess) — starts `net/http` server bound to Unix socket.
- WebSocket upgrade uses `http.Hijacker` + raw upgrade (no gorilla/websocket for serving side).
- Bundle is `bin/knirvarena.tar.gz` embedded via `//go:embed`.
- Go version 1.24.0 for the module, project backend uses 1.25.7.
- Import path in backend: `knirvarena` with `replace knirvarena => ../pkg/knirvarena`.
- No mocks, no TODOs, no placeholders in final implementation.
- All tests must pass; README updated if API changes.

## Progress
### Done
- Created `packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvarena/` directory structure with `bin/` subdirectory.
- Created placeholder `bin/knirvarena.tar.gz` (gzip-compressed tar with index.html).
- Created `pkg/knirvarena/go.mod`:
  - `module knirvarena`, `go 1.24.0`, requires `go.uber.org/zap v1.26.0`.
- Created `pkg/knirvarena/embedded.go`:
  - `//go:embed bin/knirvarena.tar.gz var embeddedBundle []byte`.
  - `ExtractEmbeddedApp(destDir string) (string, error)` with gzip magic-byte detection, tar extraction, path-traversal prevention, atomic file writes.
  - `defaultExtractDir()` supports `$KNIRV_ARENA_EXTRACT_DIR`, `$KNIRV_APP_DATA_DIR`, `/var/lib/knirvserver/knirvarena`, `~/.local/share/knirvserver/knirvarena`.
- Created `pkg/knirvarena/client.go`:
  - `Client` with Unix-socket `http.Client` transport.
  - `Health(ctx)` and `GetBaseURL()` methods.
- Created `pkg/knirvarena/manager.go`:
  - `ManagerConfig`, `Manager`, `HealthStatus` structs.
  - `DefaultConfig()`, `NewManager()`, `Extract()`, `Start()`, `Stop()`, `IsRunning()`, `IsHealthy()`, `GetHealthStatus()`, `GetSocketPath()`, `GetExtractPath()`, `GetConfig()`.
  - `handleWebSocket()` with `http.Hijacker` + raw RFC 6455 upgrade handshake + echo loop.
  - `computeAcceptKey()` using `crypto/sha1` + `encoding/base64` per RFC 6455.
  - `waitForHealth()` polling loop.
- Created `pkg/knirvarena/manager_test.go`:
  - `TestNewManager_DefaultConfig`, `TestNewManager_CustomConfig`, `TestManager_StartStop`, `TestManager_Stop_Idempotent`, `TestManager_HealthEndpoint`, `TestManager_GetHealthStatus`, `TestManager_GetSocketPath`, `TestManager_GetConfig`, `TestManager_WebSocketUpgrade`.
  - Uses `zap.NewNop()`, `testing.TempDir()`, `github.com/stretchr/testify` (matches knirvagent test pattern).
- Created `pkg/knirvarena/embedded_test.go`:
  - `TestWriteFileAtomically`, `TestWriteFileAtomically_CreatesDirs`, `TestEnsureDir`, `TestDefaultExtractDir_HonorsEnv`.
  - `TestExtractEmbeddedApp_EmptyDestDir` skipped with `t.Skip("requires real embedded bundle at compile time")`.

### In Progress
- Running `go mod tidy && go vet` on `pkg/knirvarena/`.
- Editing `packages/KNIRVSERVER/Makefile` (add ARENA_DIR, ARENA_SRC_DIR, ARENA_PKG_BUNDLE, targets, wire into backend/binary/clean/.PHONY).
- Editing `packages/KNIRVSERVER/backend/go.mod` (add `knirvarena` require + replace).
- Editing `backend/cmd/backend_server/main.go` (add `arenaMgr` field, start in init sequence, stop in shutdown).
- Editing `packages/KNIRVSERVER/main.go` (propagate `KNIRV_ARENA_SOCKET_PATH` env var to backend).
- Editing `packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/config/config.go` (add `ArenaSocketPath` field) and `internal/server/server.go` (add `/arena` proxy route).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Key Decisions
- Module named `knirvarena` (not `github.com/KNIRV/KNIRV_NETWORK/KNIRVARENA`) for consistent short import path, matching knirvhasher/knirvshell pattern.
- Backend require/replace uses `knirvarena v0.0.0-00010101000000-000000000000` / `replace knirvarena => ../pkg/knirvarena` (matches HTML spec, not `backend_server/pkg/knirvarena` pattern).
- Manager starts in-process `net/http` server bound to Unix socket (no subprocess), mirroring subprocess lifecycle.
- WebSocket upgrade done via raw `http.Hijacker` because gorilla/websocket upgrade over Unix socket proxied by external HTTP server is unreliable.

## Next Steps
1. Run `cd packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvarena && go mod tidy && go vet ./...`.
2. Edit `packages/KNIRVSERVER/Makefile` (add variables, targets, wire into dependency chain).
3. Edit `packages/KNIRVSERVER/backend/go.mod` (add require + replace for knirvarena).
4. Edit `backend/cmd/backend_server/main.go` — integrate arena manager lifecycle.
5. Edit `packages/KNIRVSERVER/main.go` — propagate `KNIRV_ARENA_SOCKET_PATH` in env vars.
6. Edit `packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/config/config.go` + `internal/server/server.go` — add arena socket path and proxy route.
7. Run `cd backend && go mod tidy` and verify full build.

## Critical Context
- `arena_implementation.html` at `/home/gperry/Documents/GitHub/KNIRV/KNIRV_NETWORK/arena_implementation.html` is the authoritative spec; files created must match its code exactly.
- Existing patterns: `pkg/knirvgraph/` (embedded binary, subprocess), `pkg/knirvagent/` (embedded binary, subprocess, test patterns).
- Backend go.mod uses `go 1.25.7`; knirvarena uses `go 1.24.0`.
- Gateway proxy for arena follows same pattern as `/network`, `/explorer` proxied to Unix sockets via `newPrefixProxy` / `unixSocketTransport`.
- The `computeAcceptKey` function uses `crypto/sha1` and `encoding/base64` (imports already added in manager.go).
- LSP errors in existing test files (`knirvagent/manager_ext_test.go`, `agent_service_test.go`) are pre-existing and not related to this work.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/gperry/Documents/GitHub/KNIRV/KNIRV_NETWORK/arena_implementation.html`: Full integration plan spec.
- `packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvarena/`: Target package directory (all source + test files created).
- `packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvagent/`: Pattern reference for go.mod, embedded.go, manager.go, tests.
- `packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvgraph/`: Pattern reference for embedded.go, manager.go, client.go.
- `packages/KNIRVSERVER/Makefile`: Must be edited with arena variables and targets.
- `packages/KNIRVSERVER/backend/go.mod`: Must add `knirvarena` require + replace.
- `packages/KNIRVSERVER/backend/cmd/backend_server/main.go`: Must integrate arena manager startup/shutdown.
- `packages/KNIRVSERVER/main.go`: Must propagate `KNIRV_ARENA_SOCKET_PATH` env var.
- `packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/config/config.go`: Must add `ArenaSocketPath` field.
- `packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/server/server.go`: Must add `/arena` proxy route in `setupRoutes()`.

 # Unified Binary (Frontend + Desktop + Backend + embedded pkg modules)
 # main.go embeds: bin/backend_server, config/*, desktop/dist/*, frontend/out/*
 # Module-owned binaries like KNIRVGATEWAY, KNIRVGRAPH, KNIRVCHAIN, KNIRVORACLE, KNIRVHASHER, KNIRVSHELL, and KNIRVAGENT
 # are embedded and extracted by their pkg modules.
 binary: proto ebpf-generate frontend backend arena-build ## Build unified binary embedding frontend, desktop, backend, KNIRVGATEWAY, KNIRVGRAPH, KNIRVCHAIN, KNIRVORACLE, KNIRVHASHER, KNIRVSHELL, KNIRVAGENT, and KNIRVARENA
 	@echo "$(BLUE)Creating unified binary (embeds frontend, desktop, backend, KNIRVGATEWAY, KNIRVGRAPH, KNIRVCHAIN, KNIRVORACLE, KNIRVHASHER, and KNIRVSHELL)...$(NC)"
 	@mkdir -p $(DIST_DIR)
 	@rm -f $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server
 	go build -ldflags "$(LDFLAGS)" -o $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server .
 	chmod 755 $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server
 	@echo "$(GREEN)Unified binary created: $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server$(NC)"
 	@echo "$(BLUE)Copying binary to container_deployer golang-app-source in app data directory...$(NC)"
 	@mkdir -p $(APPDATA_DIR)/container_deployer/resources/golang-app-source
 	@rm -f $(APPDATA_DIR)/container_deployer/resources/golang-app-source/knirv-server
 	cp $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server $(APPDATA_DIR)/container_deployer/resources/golang-app-source
 	chmod +x $(APPDATA_DIR)/container_deployer/resources/golang-app-source/knirv-server
 	@mkdir -p $(BACKEND_DIR)/cmd/container_deployer/golang-app-source
 	@rm -f $(BACKEND_DIR)/cmd/container_deployer/golang-app-source/knirv-server
 	cp $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server $(BACKEND_DIR)/cmd/container_deployer/golang-app-source
 	chmod +x $(BACKEND_DIR)/cmd/container_deployer/golang-app-source/knirv-server
 	@echo "$(GREEN)Binary copied to container_deployer/golang-app-source in both embedded backend and app data directory$(NC)"
 	@echo "$(GREEN)Good Build!$(NC)"
 
 # Quick Binary Relink (fast path, assumes all components already built)
 # Use this after making changes to frontend, desktop, backend, or embedded binaries to quickly relink without rebuilding everything
 relink: ## Quickly relink the unified binary (assumes all components already built)
 	@echo "$(BLUE)Relinking unified binary (fast path)...$(NC)"
 	@mkdir -p $(DIST_DIR)
 	@rm -f $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server
 	go build -ldflags "$(LDFLAGS)" -o $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server .
 	chmod 755 $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server
 	@echo "$(BLUE)Copying binary to container_deployer golang-app-source in app data directory...$(NC)"
 	@mkdir -p $(APPDATA_DIR)/container_deployer/resources/golang-app-source
 	@rm -f $(APPDATA_DIR)/container_deployer/resources/golang-app-source/knirv-server
 	cp $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server $(APPDATA_DIR)/container_deployer/resources/golang-app-source
 	chmod +x $(APPDATA_DIR)/container_deployer/resources/golang-app-source/knirv-server
 	@mkdir -p $(BACKEND_DIR)/cmd/container_deployer/golang-app-source
 	@rm -f $(BACKEND_DIR)/cmd/container_deployer/golang-app-source/knirv-server
 	cp $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server $(BACKEND_DIR)/cmd/container_deployer/golang-app-source
 	chmod +x $(BACKEND_DIR)/cmd/container_deployer/golang-app-source/knirv-server
 	@echo "$(GREEN)Done — binary relinked: $(DIST_DIR)/knirv-server$(NC)"

 	@echo "$(BLUE)Installing KNIRVORACLE dependencies...$(NC)"
 	cd $(ORACLE_DIR) && go mod download && go mod tidy
 
 oracle-build: oracle-deps ## Build KNIRVORACLE binary into pkg/knirvoracle/bin/ (required before binary target)
 	@echo "$(BLUE)Building KNIRVORACLE binary...$(NC)"
 	@mkdir -p $(ORACLE_PKG_DIR)/bin
 	@rm -f $(ORACLE_PKG_BIN)
 	cd $(ORACLE_DIR)/cmd/oracle && go build -ldflags "-s -w" -o $(ORACLE_PKG_BIN)
 	@echo "$(BLUE)Compressing KNIRVORACLE binary with gzip...$(NC)"
 	@rm -f $(ORACLE_PKG_BIN).tmp
 	@gzip -cf $(ORACLE_PKG_BIN) > $(ORACLE_PKG_BIN).tmp && mv $(ORACLE_PKG_BIN).tmp $(ORACLE_PKG_BIN)
 	@echo "$(GREEN)KNIRVORACLE binary built: $(ORACLE_PKG_BIN)$(NC)"
 
 oracle-clean: ## Clean KNIRVORACLE build artifacts
 	@echo "$(BLUE)Cleaning KNIRVORACLE artifacts...$(NC)"
 	rm -f $(ORACLE_PKG_BIN)
 	cd $(ORACLE_DIR) && go clean
 
 # Full build including embedded KNIRVGATEWAY (gateway-build is now a dep of binary)
 build-full: binary ## Build everything including KNIRVGATEWAY (alias for binary)

 hasher-deps: ## Install KNIRVHASHER dependencies
 	@echo "$(BLUE)Installing KNIRVHASHER dependencies...$(NC)"

 # Internal Embedded Programs - Transaction Chain (Node.js)
 transaction-chain-deps: ## Install transaction_chain dependencies

 validation-chain-build: validation-chain-deps ## Build validation_chain static library for CGo FFI and standalone HTTP binary

279: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create app data log directory: %w", err)
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	// Create file writer for app data log
283: 	appDataFile, err := os.OpenFile(appDataLogPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0666)
284: 	if err != nil {
285: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open app data log file: %w", err)
286: 	}
287: 
288: 	// Secondary log path: project directory. Prefer an explicit absolute path from the outer
289: 	// process, but fall back to the KNIRVSERVER project logs directory when we can locate it.
290: 	var multiWriter io.Writer
291: 	projectLogPath := ""
292: 	if projectLogDir := getProjectLogDir(); projectLogDir != "" {
293: 		projectLogPath = filepath.Join(projectLogDir, "server.log")
294: 		if err := os.MkdirAll(projectLogDir, 0755); err != nil {
295: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create project log directory: %w", err)
296: 		}
297: 		projectFile, err := os.OpenFile(projectLogPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0666)
298: 		if err != nil {
299: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open project log file: %w", err)
300: 		}
301: 		multiWriter = io.MultiWriter(appDataFile, projectFile)
302: 	} else {
303: 		multiWriter = appDataFile
304: 	}
305: 
306: 	// Create cores for file (both locations) and stdout
307: 	fileCore := zapcore.NewCore(
308: 		zapcore.NewJSONEncoder(encoderConfig),
309: 		zapcore.AddSync(multiWriter),
310: 		level,
311: 	)
312: 
313: 	stdoutCore := zapcore.NewCore(
314: 		zapcore.NewJSONEncoder(encoderConfig),
315: 		zapcore.AddSync(os.Stdout),
316: 		level,
317: 	)
318: 
319: 	// Combine cores - logs go to both file locations AND stdout
320: 	core := zapcore.NewTee(fileCore, stdoutCore)
321: 
322: 	// Create logger
323: 	logger := zap.New(core, zap.AddCaller(), zap.AddStacktrace(zapcore.ErrorLevel))
324: 
325: 	// Also redirect standard log output to file(s) for compatibility
326: 	log.SetOutput(multiWriter)
327: 
328: 	if projectLogPath != "" {
329: 		logger.Info("Logging initialized",
330: 			zap.String("app_data_log", appDataLogPath),
331: 			zap.String("project_log", projectLogPath),
332: 		)
333: 	} else {
334: 		logger.Info("Logging initialized",
335: 			zap.String("app_data_log", appDataLogPath),
336: 		)
337: 	}
338: 
339: 	return logger, nil
340: }

342: func getProjectLogDir() string {
343: 	if projectLogDir := os.Getenv("KNIRV_PROJECT_LOG_DIR"); projectLogDir != "" {
344: 		return projectLogDir
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	wd, err := os.Getwd()
348: 	if err != nil {
349: 		return ""
350: 	}

352: 	dir := wd
353: 	for {
354: 		if filepath.Base(dir) == "KNIRVSERVER" {
355: 			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "main.go")); err == nil {
356: 				return filepath.Join(dir, "logs")

365: 	}

368: // getOSAppDataDir returns the OS-specific application data directory
369: func getOSAppDataDir() (string, error) {
370: 	var appDataDir string
371: 	var err error
372: 	explicit := os.Getenv("KNIRV_APP_DATA_DIR")
373: 
374: 	if explicit != "" {
375: 		appDataDir = explicit
376: 	} else if err = os.MkdirAll("/var/lib/knirvserver", 0755); err == nil {
377: 		appDataDir = "/var/lib/knirvserver"
378: 	} else if xdgDataHome := os.Getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME"); xdgDataHome != "" {
379: 		appDataDir = filepath.Join(xdgDataHome, "knirvserver")
380: 	} else if homeDir, homeErr := os.UserHomeDir(); homeErr == nil {
381: 		appDataDir = filepath.Join(homeDir, ".local", "share", "knirvserver")
382: 	} else {
383: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("could not determine application data directory")
384: 	}
385: 
386: 	// Ensure directory exists
387: 	if err = os.MkdirAll(appDataDir, 0755); err != nil {
388: 		if explicit == "" {
389: 			return fallbackOSAppDataDir()
390: 		}
391: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create application data directory: %w", err)
392: 	}
393: 	if testFile, testErr := os.CreateTemp(appDataDir, ".write-test-*"); testErr == nil {
394: 		_ = testFile.Close()
395: 		_ = os.Remove(testFile.Name())
396: 	} else if explicit == "" {
397: 		return fallbackOSAppDataDir()
398: 	} else {
399: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("application data directory is not writable: %w", testErr)
400: 	}
401: 
402: 	return appDataDir, nil
403: }

413: // NewServer creates a new KNIRV-SERVER backend server instance
414: // initOracleFromKeyFile loads the encrypted root.key file and initialises the oracle service.
415: // Returns nil (no error) when the key file is absent — oracle is simply not started.
416: // The password is read from ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD env var (non-interactive/CI) or prompted
417: // from stdin when running interactively.
418: func loadSecretsFromKeyFile(logger *zap.Logger) (*pb.RootKeyFileContentProto, error) {
419: 	if logger == nil {
420: 		// Use a logger that writes to stderr so critical startup messages are
421: 		// always visible, even when the caller didn't provide a logger.
422: 		consoleLogger, _ := zap.NewProduction()
423: 		logger = consoleLogger
424: 	}
425: 
426: 	// Ensure .env files are loaded before checking environment variables.
427: 	// Try multiple search paths to find .env files with different environment names.
428: 	envSearchPaths := []string{
429: 		".env.development",
430: 		".env.testnet",
431: 		".env",
432: 		"../.env.development",
433: 		"../.env.testnet",
434: 		"../.env",
435: 		"../../.env.development",
436: 		"../../.env.testnet",
437: 		"../../.env",
438: 	}
439: 	for _, envPath := range envSearchPaths {
440: 		if err := gotenv.Load(envPath); err == nil {
441: 			logger.Info("Secrets: loaded environment file", zap.String("path", envPath))
442: 			break
443: 		}
444: 	}
445: 
446: 	configuredKeyPath, err := config.GetRootKeyPath()
447: 	if err != nil {
448: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("secrets: could not resolve root key path: %w", err)
449: 	}
450: 
451: 	keyPath, err := knirvoracle.ResolveAndValidateRootKey(configuredKeyPath)
452: 	if err != nil {
453: 		logger.Info("Secrets not loaded", zap.String("configured_path", configuredKeyPath), zap.Error(err))
454: 		return nil, nil
455: 	}
456: 
457: 	var keyPassword []byte
458: 	if envPwd := os.Getenv("ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD"); envPwd != "" {
459: 		keyPassword = []byte(envPwd)
460: 		logger.Info("Secrets: using ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD from environment")
461: 	} else {
462: 		// Check if stdin is a terminal
463: 		if !term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdin.Fd())) {
464: 			logger.Warn("Secrets not loaded: ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD is unset and stdin is not a terminal",
465: 				zap.String("key_path", keyPath))
466: 			log.Printf("WARNING: root.key found at %s but ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD is not set. "+
467: 				"API keys inside root.key (Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.) will NOT be propagated to KNIRVAGENT. "+
468: 				"Set ORACLE_KEY_PASSWORD or export GEMINI_API_KEY/DEEPSEEK_API_KEY directly.", keyPath)
469: 			return nil, nil
470: 		}
471: 		keyPassword, err = password.PromptForPassword("Enter root key password to load secrets: ")
472: 		if err != nil {
473: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("secrets: failed to read password: %w", err)
474: 		}
475: 	}
476: 
477: 	content, err := password.LoadEncryptedKeyFile(keyPath, keyPassword)
478: 	if err != nil {
479: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("secrets: failed to decrypt root.key: %w", err)
480: 	}
481: 
482: 	logger.Info("Secrets loaded from root.key", zap.String("key_path", keyPath))
483: 	return content, nil
484: }

587: func NewServer(cfg *config.Config, rootKeySecrets *pb.RootKeyFileContentProto) (*Server, error) {

593: 
594: 	// Initialize database
595: 	dbManager, err := database.NewBuntDB(cfg.Database.Path)

602: 
603: 	// Initialize eBPF Manager first (required for P2P security integration)
604: 	ebpfManager := ebpf.NewManager()
605: 	ebpfConfig := &ebpf.Config{
606: 		Programs: []ebpf.ProgramConfig{
607: 			{Name: "syscall_trace", Enabled: true},

609: 			{Name: "virtual_ns", Enabled: true},
610: 			{Name: "telemetry", Enabled: true},
611: 		},

614: 	// Initialize eBPF manager with context

617: 		log.Printf("Warning: Failed to initialize eBPF manager: %v", err)

619: 		ebpfManager = nil // Disable eBPF if initialization fails
620: 	} else {
621: 		log.Println("eBPF Manager initialized successfully")
622: 	}
623: 
624: 	// Initialize XDP Manager and P2P Security Service (eBPF/XDP firewall integration)

636: 				if err := p2pSecurityService.Start(); err != nil {

638: 					p2pSecurityService = nil
639: 				} else {
640: 					log.Println("P2P Security Service initialized successfully")
641: 				}
642: 			}
643: 		}
644: 	}
645: 
646: 	// Initialize P2P manager with security integration

652: 	// Create router

655: 	var transactionChainClient *transactionchain.Client

657: 
658: 	// Initialize services

661: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize DVE manager: %w", err)

239: 	if err != nil {
240: 		return nil, err
241: 	}
242: 
243: 	normalizePrefix := func(prefix string) string {

252:

254: 		Director: func(req *http.Request) {
255: 			req.URL.Scheme = target.Scheme
256: 			req.URL.Host = target.Host
257: 
258: 			incomingPath := req.URL.Path
259: 			if incomingPath == "" {
260: 				incomingPath = "/"
261: 			}
262: 
263: 			trimmed := incomingPath
264: 			if sourcePrefix != "" && strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, sourcePrefix) {

266: 			}
267: 			if trimmed == "" {

269: 			}

289: 			if sourcePrefix != "" && strings.Contains(ct, "text/html") {

291: 				if err != nil {

531: func extractEnvFile(environment string) error {
532: 	var envData []byte
533: 	var envName string
534: 
535: 	switch environment {
536: 	case "development":

538: 		envName = ".env.development"

540: 		envData = envTestnet
541: 		envName = ".env.testnet"

544: 		// or configured through environment variables

631: func writeFileAtomically(path string, data []byte, perm os.FileMode) error {
632: 	dir := filepath.Dir(path)
633: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
634: 		return err
635: 	}
636: 
637: 	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, "."+filepath.Base(path)+".tmp-*")
638: 	if err != nil {
639: 		return err
640: 	}
641: 	tmpPath := tmp.Name()
642: 	cleanup := true
643: 	defer func() {
644: 		if cleanup {
645: 			_ = os.Remove(tmpPath)
646: 		}
647: 	}()
648: 
649: 	if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
650: 		_ = tmp.Close()
651: 		return err
652: 	}
653: 	if err := tmp.Chmod(perm); err != nil {
654: 		_ = tmp.Close()
655: 		return err
656: 	}
657: 	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
658: 		return err
659: 	}
660: 	if err := os.Rename(tmpPath, path); err != nil {
661: 		return err
662: 	}
663: 
664: 	cleanup = false
665: 	return nil
666: }

800: 				}
801: 				if app.upd == nil {

804: 				}

807: 				c.Writer.(http.Flusher).Flush()

816: 			// Detect network-monitor paths and proxy to the gateway instead

826: 			// (cannot register as a named Gin route; /api/*path catch-all owns the prefix)
827: 			if strings.HasPrefix(c.Request.URL.Path, "/api/agent/") {
828: 				agentProxy, agentErr := newPrefixProxy(gatewayBase, gatewayTransport, "", "")
829: 				if agentErr == nil {
830: 					agentProxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
831: 					return
832: 				}
833: 			}
834: 			// Construct backend URL
835: 			backendURL := backendBaseURL(app.config) + c.Request.RequestURI
836: 			transport := &http.Transport{}
837: 			if app.config.BackendSocket != "" {
838: 				transport = unixSocketTransport(app.config.BackendSocket)
839: 			}
840: 
841: 			// Create proxy request
842: 			req, err := http.NewRequest(c.Request.Method, backendURL, c.Request.Body)
843: 			if err != nil {
844: 				c.JSON(500, gin.H{"error": "Failed to create proxy request"})
845: 				return
846: 			}

848: 			// Copy headers
849: 			for key, values := range c.Request.Header {
850: 				for _, value := range values {

853: 			}

860: 				CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {

864: 			resp, err := client.Do(req)

869: 			}
870: 			defer resp.Body.Close()

872: 			// Copy response headers
873: 			for key, values := range resp.Header {
874: 				for _, value := range values {
875: 					c.Header(key, value)
876: 				}
877: 			}

879: 			// Copy response status and body

902: 		}

904: 		proxy, err := newPrefixProxy(gatewayBase, gatewayTransport, "", "")

912: 	// WebSocket proxy — must be registered before NoRoute so the upgrade
913: 	// request reaches the backend instead of being served as a static file.
914: 	// httputil.ReverseProxy handles the 101 Switching Protocols upgrade by
915: 	// hijacking the underlying net.Conn, which works through Gin's wrapper.
916: 	var backendWS *url.URL
917: 	var wsTransport *http.Transport
918: 
919: 	if app.config.BackendSocket != "" {
920: 		backendWS, _ = url.Parse("http://localhost")
921: 		wsTransport = unixSocketTransport(app.config.BackendSocket)
922: 	} else {
923: 		backendWS, _ = url.Parse(fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", app.config.BackendPort))
924: 		wsTransport = &http.Transport{}
925: 	}
926: 
927: 	wsProxy := &httputil.ReverseProxy{
928: 		Director: func(req *http.Request) {
929: 			req.URL.Scheme = backendWS.Scheme
930: 			req.URL.Host = backendWS.Host
931: 		},
932: 		Transport: wsTransport,
933: 	}
934: 	wsProxy.FlushInterval = -1 // flush immediately; required for streaming / WebSocket
935: 	wsProxy.ErrorHandler = func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
936: 		// The error handler is only invoked before the connection is hijacked,
937: 		// so it is safe to write an HTTP error response here.
938: 		log.Printf("WebSocket proxy error for %s: %v", r.URL.Path, err)
939: 		http.Error(w, "WebSocket backend unavailable", http.StatusBadGateway)
940: 	}

942: 	wsHandler := func(c *gin.Context) {
943: 		// All WebSocket paths — including /ws/dve/{dveId}/inner/* for inner agent PTY
944: 		// streams — are handled by the backend subprocess (gorilla/mux), which has the
945: 		// DVEInnerAgentWSHandler registered and connects directly to per-DVE sockets.
946: 		wsProxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
947: 	}
948: 	app.router.GET("/ws", wsHandler)
949: 	app.router.GET("/ws/*path", wsHandler)

951: 	// Serve embedded frontend files.
952: 	// Before falling through to the main frontend static files, check if
953: 	// the request is a dynamic asset load from the gateway SPA (identified
954: 	// by a Referer header pointing to a gateway route).  The gateway's
955: 	// Next.js app lazy-loads route chunks with hardcoded /_next/ paths
956: 	// that our HTML rewrite cannot intercept — these arrive here via NoRoute.
957: 	app.router.NoRoute(func(c *gin.Context) {
958: 		// If the Referer indicates this is a sub-request from the gateway
959: 		// SPA (e.g. a dynamically-imported page chunk), proxy it through
960: 		// the gateway's Unix socket so it gets the correct asset.
961: 		if referer := c.GetHeader("Referer"); referer != "" {
962: 			refURL, err := url.Parse(referer)
963: 			if err == nil && (strings.HasPrefix(refURL.Path, "/gateway") ||
964: 				refURL.Path == "/dashboard" ||
965: 				refURL.Path == "/chain-explorer" ||
966: 				refURL.Path == "/graph-explorer" ||
967: 				refURL.Path == "/error-explorer") {
968: 				gwProxy, gwErr := newPrefixProxy(gatewayBase, gatewayTransport, "", "")
969: 				if gwErr == nil {
970: 					gwProxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
971: 					return
972: 				}
973: 			}
974: 		}
975: 		// Proxy known gateway SPA routes through the gateway at the same path,
976: 		// preserving the route so the WebGUI loads the correct page.  The
977: 		// gateway serves individual HTML pages (dashboard.html, etc.) with
978: 		// injected __GATEWAY_BASE__ config.  Using the same path avoids the
979: 		// "always shows /explorer" problem that a blanket redirect to /gateway
980: 		// would cause.
981: 		path := c.Request.URL.Path
982: 		if path == "/dashboard" || path == "/chain-explorer" || path == "/graph-explorer" || path == "/error-explorer" {
983: 			gwProxy, gwErr := newPrefixProxy(gatewayBase, gatewayTransport, "", "")
984: 			if gwErr == nil {
985: 				gwProxy.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
986: 				return
987: 			}
988: 		}
989: 		embeddedFS.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
990: 	})
991: 
992: 	return nil
993: }

995: // killStaleBackend sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL to any running backend_server processes
996: // so port 4001 (P2P/libp2p) and other ports are free before a new instance starts.
997: func killStaleBackend(binaryPath string) {
998: 	binaryName := filepath.Base(binaryPath)
999: 	if binaryName == "" || binaryName == "." {
1000: 		binaryName = "backend_server"
1001: 	}
1002: 	if cmd := exec.Command("pkill", "-TERM", "-x", binaryName); cmd.Run() == nil {
1003: 		time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
1004: 	}
1005: 	exec.Command("pkill", "-KILL", "-x", binaryName).Run() //nolint:errcheck
1006: }

1008: // waitForPortFreeMain blocks until the given TCP port is no longer occupied or the deadline.
1009: func waitForPortFreeMain(port int, deadline time.Duration) bool {
1010: 	end := time.Now().Add(deadline)
1011: 	for time.Now().Before(end) {
1012: 		ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf(":%d", port))
1013: 		if err == nil {
1014: 			ln.Close()
1015: 			return true
1016: 		}
1017: 		time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
1018: 	}
1019: 	return false
1020: }

1022: // startBackend starts the embedded unified backend service

1714: 	for _, hb := range icmeObj.HardBoundaries {
1715: 		if parts := strings.SplitN(hb, "=", 2); len(parts) == 2 {

1718: 			if strings.HasSuffix(parts[1], "(soft)") {
1719: 				if obj.SoftLimits == nil {
1720: 					obj.SoftLimits = make(map[string]float64)
1721: 				}
1722: 				obj.SoftLimits[strings.TrimSuffix(parts[0], "(soft)")] = val
1723: 			} else {
1724: 				if obj.HardBoundaries == nil {
1725: 					obj.HardBoundaries = make(map[string]float64)
1726: 				}
1727: 				obj.HardBoundaries[parts[0]] = val
1728: 			}

1734: 		}

1736: 	}

2180: func (s *Server) runRollupLoop() {
2181: 	if s.rollupService == nil {
2182: 		return
2183: 	}
2184: 
2185: 	pollInterval := s.rollupPollInterval
2186: 	if pollInterval <= 0 {
2187: 		pollInterval = 30 * time.Second
2188: 	}
2189: 
2190: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(pollInterval)
2191: 	go func() {
2192: 		defer ticker.Stop()
2193: 		for {
2194: 			select {
2195: 			case <-s.ctx.Done():
2196: 				return
2197: 			case <-ticker.C:
2198: 				batch, err := s.rollupService.BuildNextBatch(s.ctx)
2199: 				if err != nil {
2200: 					log.Printf("Warning: Failed to build rollup batch: %v", err)
2201: 					continue
2202: 				}
2203: 				if batch == nil {
2204: 				} else {
2205: 					submitted, err := s.rollupService.SubmitBatch(s.ctx, batch.ID)
2206: 					if err != nil {
2207: 						log.Printf("Warning: Failed to submit rollup batch %s: %v", batch.ID, err)
2208: 						continue
2209: 					}
2210: 
2211: 					log.Printf("Rollup batch submitted: %s (heights %d-%d)", submitted.ID, submitted.StartHeight, submitted.EndHeight)
2212: 				}
2213: 
2214: 				reconciled, err := s.rollupService.ReconcileWithOracle(s.ctx)
2215: 				if err != nil {
2216: 					log.Printf("Warning: Failed to reconcile rollup batches with oracle: %v", err)
2217: 					continue
2218: 				}
2219: 				if reconciled > 0 {
2220: 					log.Printf("Reconciled %d rollup batch statuses from oracle", reconciled)
2221: 				}
2222: 			}
2223: 		}
2224: 	}()
2225: }

647: // findAvailablePort tries to listen on the given port, and if it's in use,
648: // tries subsequent ports until it finds one available.
649: func (s *Server) findAvailablePort(startPort int) (net.Listener, error) {
650: 	const maxAttempts = 100
651: 	for port := startPort; port < startPort+maxAttempts; port++ {
652: 		addr := fmt.Sprintf(":%d", port)
653: 		listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", addr)
654: 		if err != nil {
655: 			s.logger.Debug("Port in use, trying next",
656: 				zap.Int("port", port),
657: 				zap.Error(err),
658: 			)
659: 			continue
660: 		}
661: 		s.logger.Info("Found available port",
662: 			zap.Int("port", port),
663: 		)
664: 		return listener, nil
665: 	}
666: 	return nil, fmt.Errorf("no available port found after %d attempts", maxAttempts)
667: }

669: // Start starts the HTTP server
670: func (s *Server) Start() error {
671: 	ctx := context.Background()
672: 
673: 	// Start tunnel service
674: 	if err := s.tunnelService.Start(ctx); err != nil {
675: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start tunnel service: %w", err)
676: 	}
677: 
678: 	// Start payment service
679: 	if err := s.paymentService.Start(ctx); err != nil {
680: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start payment service: %w", err)
681: 	}
682: 
683: 	// Start TURN server with blockchain integration
684: 	if s.turnServer != nil {
685: 		if err := s.turnServer.Start(ctx); err != nil {
686: 			s.logger.Warn("Failed to start TURN server",
687: 				zap.Error(err))
688: 		}
689: 	}
690: 
691: 	// Setup CORS
692: 	c := cors.New(cors.Options{
693: 		AllowedOrigins:   []string{"*"},
694: 		AllowedMethods:   []string{"GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"},
695: 		AllowedHeaders:   []string{"*"},
696: 		AllowCredentials: true,
697: 	})
698: 
699: 	handler := c.Handler(wrapWithSecurityHeaders(s.router))
700: 
701: 	s.httpServer = &http.Server{
702: 		Addr:         fmt.Sprintf(":%d", s.config.Port),
703: 		Handler:      handler,
704: 		ReadTimeout:  30 * time.Second,
705: 		WriteTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
706: 		IdleTimeout:  120 * time.Second,
707: 	}
708: 
709: 	var listener net.Listener
710: 	var err error
711: 
712: 	// Listen on TCP port
713: 	listener, err = s.findAvailablePort(s.config.Port)
714: 	if err != nil {
715: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to find available port: %w", err)
716: 	}
717: 	// Extract the actual port from the listener
718: 	s.actualPort = listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
719: 	if s.actualPort != s.config.Port {
720: 		s.logger.Info("Using dynamic port",
721: 			zap.Int("port", s.actualPort),
722: 			zap.Int("requested", s.config.Port),
723: 		)
724: 	} else {
725: 		s.actualPort = s.config.Port
726: 	}
727: 
728: 	s.logger.Info("HTTP server listening",
729: 		zap.String("address", s.httpServer.Addr),
730: 	)
731: 
732: 	if err := s.httpServer.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
733: 		return fmt.Errorf("server failed: %w", err)
734: 	}
735: 
736: 	return nil
737: }

767: // injectGatewayBase reads an HTML file and injects a <script> tag with
768: // __GATEWAY_BASE__, __PAYMENT_API__, and KNIRV_GATEWAY_CONFIG configuration
769: // before </head>.  KNIRV_GATEWAY_CONFIG is read by gateway-links.js as its
770: // primary config source — without it the JS falls back to hardcoded
771: // localhost:3001 for the payment oracle health check and other endpoints.
772: func (s *Server) injectGatewayBase(filePath string) ([]byte, error) {
773: 	data, err := os.ReadFile(filePath)
774: 	if err != nil {
775: 		return nil, err
776: 	}
777: 	gatewayBase := fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", s.config.Port)
778: 	script := fmt.Sprintf(
779: 		`<script>window.__GATEWAY_BASE__=%q;window.__PAYMENT_API__="/api/v1/payments";window.KNIRV_GATEWAY_CONFIG=%s;</script>`,
780: 		gatewayBase,
781: 		knirvGatewayConfigJSON(s.config),
782: 	)
783: 	injected := strings.Replace(string(data), "</head>", script+"</head>", 1)
784: 	return []byte(injected), nil

798: 		base, gatewayPort, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))

801: // wrapWithSecurityHeaders adds security-related HTTP headers to all responses.
802: func wrapWithSecurityHeaders(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
803: 	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
804: 		w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "SAMEORIGIN")
805: 		w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "frame-ancestors 'self' http://localhost:8080 http://localhost:8090")
806: 		w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
807: 		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
808: 	})
809: }

811: // newSocketProxy creates a reverse proxy that dials a Unix socket and forwards
812: // requests to the given target base URL.
813: func newSocketProxy(socketPath, targetBase string) *httputil.ReverseProxy {
814: 	transport := &http.Transport{
815: 		DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) (net.Conn, error) {
816: 			return net.Dial("unix", socketPath)
817: 		},
818: 	}
819: 	target, _ := url.Parse(targetBase)
820: 	proxy := httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(target)
821: 	proxy.Transport = transport
822: 	// Strip CORS headers from the upstream response so the gateway's own CORS
823: 	// middleware is the single authority.  Without this the backend can inject
824: 	// Access-Control-Allow-Origin alongside the gateway's wildcard, producing
825: 	// the "multiple values" error browsers reject.
826: 	proxy.ModifyResponse = func(resp *http.Response) error {
827: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Origin")
828: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Headers")
829: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Methods")
830: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials")
831: 		// Strip frame/CSP headers from the upstream response so the gateway's own
832: 		// wrapWithSecurityHeaders (SAMEORIGIN, proper frame-ancestors CSP) is
833: 		// authoritative.  Without this the backend's SecurityHeadersMiddleware
834: 		// (X-Frame-Options: DENY, default-src 'self') overrides the gateway's
835: 		// permissive settings and blocks iframing in components like the DVE
836: 		// verification panel.
837: 		resp.Header.Del("X-Frame-Options")
838: 		resp.Header.Del("Content-Security-Policy")
839: 		return nil
840: 	}
841: 	return proxy
842: }

844: // dynamicAgentProxy returns an http.Handler that routes /api/agent/{dveId}/*
845: // to the per-DVE KNIRVAGENT's Unix socket (agent-{dveId}.sock).
846: // The proxy is created on first use and cached per DVE ID.
847: func (s *Server) dynamicAgentProxy() http.Handler {
848: 	var (
849: 		mu     sync.RWMutex
850: 		cache  = make(map[string]*httputil.ReverseProxy)
851: 	)
852: 	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
853: 		// Extract DVE ID from path: /api/agent/{dveId}/rest/of/path
854: 		path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/agent/")
855: 		parts := strings.SplitN(path, "/", 2)
856: 		if len(parts) == 0 || parts[0] == "" {
857: 			http.Error(w, `{"error":"missing dve id"}`, http.StatusBadRequest)
858: 			return
859: 		}

909: // handleInnerAgentWS upgrades the HTTP connection to a WebSocket and
910: // pipes data to/from the KNIRVAGENT's Unix socket for inner agent

912: func (s *Server) handleInnerAgentWS(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
913: 	vars := mux.Vars(r)
914: 	dveID := vars["dveId"]
915: 	sessionID := vars["sessionId"]
916: 
917: 	if dveID == "" {
918: 		http.Error(w, `{"error":"dveId required"}`, http.StatusBadRequest)
919: 		return
920: 	}
921: 
922: 	socketPath := filepath.Join(s.config.AgentSocketDir, fmt.Sprintf("agent-%s.sock", dveID))
923: 	if _, err := os.Stat(socketPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
924: 		s.logger.Warn("Inner agent WS: socket not found", zap.String("dveID", dveID), zap.String("socket", socketPath))
925: 		http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf(`{"error":"agent not running for dve %s"}`, dveID), http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
926: 		return
927: 	}
928: 
929: 	conn, err := innerAgentUpgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
930: 	if err != nil {
931: 		s.logger.Error("Inner agent WS upgrade failed", zap.String("dveID", dveID), zap.Error(err))
932: 		return
933: 	}
934: 	defer conn.Close()
935: 
936: 	unixConn, err := net.DialTimeout("unix", socketPath, 5*time.Second)
937: 	if err != nil {
938: 		s.logger.Error("Inner agent WS: Unix dial failed", zap.String("dveID", dveID), zap.String("socket", socketPath), zap.Error(err))
939: 		conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"type":"error","data":"cannot connect to agent"}`))
940: 		return
941: 	}
942: 	defer unixConn.Close()
943: 
944: 	if sessionID != "" {
945: 		httpReq := "GET /api/inner/" + sessionID + "/stream HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: unix\r\n\r\n"
946: 		if _, err := unixConn.Write([]byte(httpReq)); err != nil {
947: 			s.logger.Error("Inner agent WS: stream request failed", zap.String("dveID", dveID), zap.Error(err))
948: 			return
949: 		}
950: 	}
951: 
952: 	errCh := make(chan error, 2)
953: 
954: 	go func() {
955: 		buf := make([]byte, 4096)
956: 		for {
957: 			n, err := unixConn.Read(buf)
958: 			if n > 0 {
959: 				msg, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"type": "data", "data": string(buf[:n])})
960: 				if writeErr := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg); writeErr != nil {
961: 					errCh <- writeErr
962: 					return
963: 				}
964: 			}
965: 			if err != nil {
966: 				endMsg, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"type": "stream_end"})
967: 				conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, endMsg)
968: 				errCh <- err
969: 				return
970: 			}
971: 		}
972: 	}()
973: 
974: 	go func() {
975: 		for {
976: 			_, message, err := conn.ReadMessage()
977: 			if err != nil {
978: 				errCh <- err
979: 				return
980: 			}
981: 			var msg struct {
982: 				Type    string `json:"type"`
983: 				Data    string `json:"data,omitempty"`
984: 				Session string `json:"session,omitempty"`
985: 			}
986: 			if err := json.Unmarshal(message, &msg); err != nil {
987: 				continue
988: 			}
989: 			switch msg.Type {
990: 			case "input":
991: 				targetSession := msg.Session
992: 				if targetSession == "" {
993: 					targetSession = sessionID
994: 				}
995: 				if targetSession == "" {
996: 					continue
997: 				}
998: 				body := fmt.Sprintf("data=%s", msg.Data)
999: 				inputReq := fmt.Sprintf("POST /api/inner/%s/input HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: unix\r\nContent-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s",
1000: 					targetSession, len(body), body)
1001: 				unixConn.Write([]byte(inputReq))
1002: 			case "ping":
1003: 				conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"type":"pong"}`))
1004: 			}
1005: 		}
1006: 	}()
1007: 
1008: 	<-errCh
1009: }

238: // initLogging initializes the logging system based on configuration
239: func initLogging(cfg *config.Config) (*zap.Logger, error) {
240: 	// Determine log level
241: 	var level zapcore.Level
242: 	switch cfg.Log.Level {
243: 	case "debug":
244: 		level = zapcore.DebugLevel
245: 	case "info":
246: 		level = zapcore.InfoLevel
247: 	case "warn":
248: 		level = zapcore.WarnLevel
249: 	case "error":
250: 		level = zapcore.ErrorLevel
251: 	default:
252: 		level = zapcore.InfoLevel
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	// Create encoder config
256: 	encoderConfig := zapcore.EncoderConfig{
257: 		TimeKey:        "timestamp",
258: 		LevelKey:       "level",
259: 		NameKey:        "logger",
260: 		CallerKey:      "caller",
261: 		FunctionKey:    zapcore.OmitKey,
262: 		MessageKey:     "message",
263: 		StacktraceKey:  "stacktrace",
264: 		LineEnding:     zapcore.DefaultLineEnding,
265: 		EncodeLevel:    zapcore.LowercaseLevelEncoder,
266: 		EncodeTime:     zapcore.ISO8601TimeEncoder,
267: 		EncodeDuration: zapcore.SecondsDurationEncoder,
268: 		EncodeCaller:   zapcore.ShortCallerEncoder,
269: 	}
270: 
271: 	// Get application data directory for log storage
272: 	appDataDir, err := getOSAppDataDir()
273: 	if err != nil {
274: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get application data directory: %w", err)
275: 	}
276: 
277: 	// Primary log path: application data directory
278: 	appDataLogPath := filepath.Join(appDataDir, "logs", "server.log")
279: 
280: 	// Ensure app data log directory exists
281: 	appDataLogDir := filepath.Dir(appDataLogPath)
282: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(appDataLogDir, 0755); err != nil {
283: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create app data log directory: %w", err)
284: 	}
285: 
286: 	// Create file writer for app data log
287: 	appDataFile, err := os.OpenFile(appDataLogPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0666)
288: 	if err != nil {
289: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open app data log file: %w", err)
290: 	}
291: 
292: 	// Secondary log path: project directory. Prefer an explicit absolute path from the outer
293: 	// process, but fall back to the KNIRVSERVER project logs directory when we can locate it.
294: 	var multiWriter io.Writer
295: 	projectLogPath := ""
296: 	if projectLogDir := getProjectLogDir(); projectLogDir != "" {
297: 		projectLogPath = filepath.Join(projectLogDir, "server.log")
298: 		if err := os.MkdirAll(projectLogDir, 0755); err != nil {
299: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create project log directory: %w", err)
300: 		}
301: 		projectFile, err := os.OpenFile(projectLogPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0666)
302: 		if err != nil {
303: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open project log file: %w", err)
304: 		}
305: 		multiWriter = io.MultiWriter(appDataFile, projectFile)
306: 	} else {
307: 		multiWriter = appDataFile
308: 	}
309: 
310: 	// Create cores for file (both locations) and stdout
311: 	fileCore := zapcore.NewCore(
312: 		zapcore.NewJSONEncoder(encoderConfig),
313: 		zapcore.AddSync(multiWriter),
314: 		level,
315: 	)
316: 
317: 	stdoutCore := zapcore.NewCore(
318: 		zapcore.NewJSONEncoder(encoderConfig),
319: 		zapcore.AddSync(os.Stdout),
320: 		level,
321: 	)
322: 
323: 	// Combine cores - logs go to both file locations AND stdout
324: 	core := zapcore.NewTee(fileCore, stdoutCore)
325: 
326: 	// Create logger
327: 	logger := zap.New(core, zap.AddCaller(), zap.AddStacktrace(zapcore.ErrorLevel))
328: 
329: 	// Also redirect standard log output to file(s) for compatibility
330: 	log.SetOutput(multiWriter)
331: 
332: 	if projectLogPath != "" {
333: 		logger.Info("Logging initialized",
334: 			zap.String("app_data_log", appDataLogPath),
335: 			zap.String("project_log", projectLogPath),
336: 		)
337: 	} else {
338: 		logger.Info("Logging initialized",
339: 			zap.String("app_data_log", appDataLogPath),
340: 		)
341: 	}
342: 
343: 	return logger, nil
344: }

346: func getProjectLogDir() string {
347: 	if projectLogDir := os.Getenv("KNIRV_PROJECT_LOG_DIR"); projectLogDir != "" {
348: 		return projectLogDir
349: 	}
350: 
351: 	wd, err := os.Getwd()
352: 	if err != nil {
353: 		return ""
354: 	}
355: 
356: 	dir := wd
357: 	for {
358: 		if filepath.Base(dir) == "KNIRVSERVER" {
359: 			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "main.go")); err == nil {
360: 				return filepath.Join(dir, "logs")
361: 			}
362: 		}
363: 
364: 		parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
365: 		if parent == dir {
366: 			return ""
367: 		}
368: 		dir = parent
369: 	}
370: }

372: // getOSAppDataDir returns the OS-specific application data directory
373: func getOSAppDataDir() (string, error) {
374: 	var appDataDir string
375: 	var err error
376: 	explicit := os.Getenv("KNIRV_APP_DATA_DIR")
377: 
378: 	if explicit != "" {
379: 		appDataDir = explicit
380: 	} else if err = os.MkdirAll("/var/lib/knirvserver", 0755); err == nil {
381: 		appDataDir = "/var/lib/knirvserver"
382: 	} else if xdgDataHome := os.Getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME"); xdgDataHome != "" {
383: 		appDataDir = filepath.Join(xdgDataHome, "knirvserver")
384: 	} else if homeDir, homeErr := os.UserHomeDir(); homeErr == nil {
385: 		appDataDir = filepath.Join(homeDir, ".local", "share", "knirvserver")
386: 	} else {
387: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("could not determine application data directory")
388: 	}
389: 
390: 	// Ensure directory exists
391: 	if err = os.MkdirAll(appDataDir, 0755); err != nil {
392: 		if explicit == "" {
393: 			return fallbackOSAppDataDir()
394: 		}
395: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create application data directory: %w", err)
396: 	}
397: 	if testFile, testErr := os.CreateTemp(appDataDir, ".write-test-*"); testErr == nil {
398: 		_ = testFile.Close()
399: 		_ = os.Remove(testFile.Name())
400: 	} else if explicit == "" {
401: 		return fallbackOSAppDataDir()
402: 	} else {
403: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("application data directory is not writable: %w", testErr)
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	return appDataDir, nil
407: }
